Hand-Written Question: Where is gauging station “Water of Dye at Charr” located?
What are the gauging station locations of the five largest catchments by area?
What is the boundary of the catchment monitored by sensor 3003?
Which catchments share a boundary with the catchment that recorded the highest total precipitation between 2012 and 2015?
What is the area of the largest catchment in the dataset?
Query:
PREFIX hyobs: <https://w3id.org/hmontology/>
PREFIX qudt:  <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
PREFIX xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX envthes: <http://vocabs.lter-europe.net/EnvThes/>

SELECT ?catchment ?area
WHERE {
  GRAPH <hydroturtle/camels_gb> {
    ?catchment a envthes:30212.
    ?catchment hyobs:hasCatchmentArea ?areaNode .
    ?areaNode qudt:numericValue ?area .
  }
}
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:decimal(?area))
LIMIT 1
